day_line: The sun on a Monkey day. Bright and quick: good for fresh ideas and getting people moving, easy to scatter your energy.

lines.Yang Wood: Your good mood spreads today. Start the kopi run; finish your own task first.
lines.Yin Wood: Your words land well today. Send the feedback, but read it out loud once first.
lines.Yang Fire: Like-minded people show up today. Pair up on the big task and split the credit fairly.
lines.Yin Fire: Someone eyes the same prize today. Run your own race; no need to check theirs every hour.
lines.Yang Earth: A hunch makes sense today. Follow it, but check one fact before you act.
lines.Yin Earth: Help arrives without asking today. Say yes to the lift home and thank them properly.
lines.Yang Metal: Wednesday turns up the heat. Take the hardest task first, then give yourself a real break.
lines.Yin Metal: Your neat work gets seen today. Take the compliment; don't list what's wrong with it.
lines.Yang Water: An extra chance pops up midweek. Say you're keen, then ask what it really involves.
lines.Yin Water: Steady wins the money today. Top up the savings first, then enjoy the bubble tea.
